items.title: Mankind Pharma, Dr Lal: Shrikant Chouhan bullish on 2 healthcare stocks
items.description: Stocks to buy today: Shrikant Chouhan of Kotak Neo has shared a bullish view on two healthcare stocks: Mankind Pharma and Dr Lal Pathlabs.

items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex surges nearly 900 pts, Nifty tops 23,600; Marico, Angel One lead SMID gain
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Tuesday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap rose 0.82 per cent and 0.55 per cent, respectively

items.title: Nifty Private Bank index gains 2%; HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank shine
items.description: In the past five trading days, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank rallied 7% each against 5% rise in the Nifty 50.

items.title: Fusion Finance share price zooms nearly 16% on Q2 turnaround
items.description: Fusion Finance reported a net profit of ₹86.48 crore in Q2FY27 against a net loss of ₹22.14 crore in Q2FY26.

items.title: Textile, garment stocks in demand; Kitex, Trident, Gokaldas rally up to 18%
items.description: Share prices of Kitex Garments zoomed 18% and Trident surged 13% on the back of heavy volume in Tuesday's trading session.

items.title: GRSE jumps 9% on ₹53,866-crore deal; logs best one-day gain in 6 months
items.description: The Defence Ministry sealed ₹53,866 crore contracts worth with GRSE and Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL) to procure eight next-generation warships for the Indian Navy to bolster its combat prowess.

items.title: Sensex soars 3,300-points in 4 days: Is it time to sell the rally?
items.description: Consider today's intraday high of 76,573, Sensex has rallied a whopping 3325 points or 4.5 per cent in just four sessions. Meanwhile, its NSE counterpart Nifty is eyeing to reclaim the 23,700 mark.

items.title: Bosch jumps 5%, hits new high on bonus, stock split plan; up 76% since Apr
items.description: Analysts expect Bosch's Q2 revenue to grow 50% YoY, driven by consolidation of the RBIC acquisition, healthy growth outperformance in the automotive segment, and recovery in the non-mobility segment.

items.title: Oil market at crossroads as US-Iran diplomacy reshapes outlook: Analyst
items.description: Mohammed Imran of Mirae Asset Sharekhan said that oil market is entering a highly sensitive phase as geopolitical risks are weighed against the possibility of a breakthrough in the US-Iran crisis.

items.title: Nifty Smallcap looks stronger vs Midcap index, can hit new high: Analysts
items.description: Nandish Shah of HDFC Securities believes that the Nifty Smallcap 250 index seems favourably placed on charts compared to the Midcap 150 index, and can potentially rally to new highs from here on.

items.title: Nifty Capital Markets rallies 2%; Motilal Oswal, Angel One surge up to 7%
items.description: At 10:18 AM on Tuesday, the Nifty Capital Markets index was up 2.43%, compared to a 0.83% rise in the Nifty 50.

items.title: KEC International falls 8% as Q2 profit sinks 82%, margins contract sharply
items.description: KEC International, a Mumbai-based EPC major, has reported an 82 per cent Y-o-Y decline in its consolidated net profit to ₹30 crore in Q2FY27.

items.title: Crude-sensitive stocks gain as oil stays below $105; HPCL, IndiGo lead
items.description: Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, was marginally up but remained below $105 per barrel. It was up 0.10 per cent at $104.9, while West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude rose 0.18 per cent to $96.63.

items.title: Small-cap stock Kitex Garments zooms over 17% as firm swings to black in Q2
items.description: Despite today's rise, Kitex Garments shares continue to trade 41 per cent below their 52-week high of ₹231.15, touched in February this year.

items.title: SFC Environment Technologies' shares list at 7.5% premium over IPO price
items.description: SFC Environment Technologies' debut beat expectations as the grey market premium (GMP) was 4.70 per cent, according to websites tracking the unofficial market.

items.title: BLS Polymers IPO investors gain 65% as shares make strong debut on bourses
items.description: BLS Polymers shares listed at ₹248 on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), a premium of ₹98 or 65.3 per cent over the IPO issue price of ₹150.

items.title: Balrampur Chini, Triveni surge up to 9%; what's driving sugar stocks?
items.description: Triveni Engineering reported a profit after tax of ₹94 crore for Q2FY27, against a net loss of ₹11 crore in the same quarter last fiscal year.

items.title: ITC up 1% after weak Q2; analysts see gradual recovery in cigarette biz
items.description: Cigarette-to-soap conglomerate ITC reported an 18.7 per cent year-on-year (Y-o-Y) drop in consolidated net profit.

items.title: Marico shares spurt 6% on robust Q2 earnings, positive revision in guidance
items.description: Marico reported a 29.16 per cent rise in consolidated net profit to ₹558 crore in the September quarter of FY27, led by strong volume growth in the domestic market.

items.title: RIL stock in focus: What next after near 12% surge? Analyst decodes history
items.description: An analysis of RIL's 26-year share price data by SAMCO Securities shows that the stock has recorded an average gain of 55.3% in the next 1-year after rallying over 5% in a single trading session.

items.title: Jio Platforms listing a re-rating catalyst for telecom sector: MOFSL
items.description: Motilal Oswal Wealth Management Research Desk said that the listing of Jio Platforms is a significant development for the telecom sector, with potential valuation implications for Airtel and RIL
